news.title: Push is on to boost career tech in Michigan schools. Not all agree that’s best
news.summary_en: Nearly 115,000 students took a career and technical education course last year. But is it a direct path to a good job? Leaders say employers want even more training and schools need more trained instructors.
news.author: Isabel Lohman

news.title: University of Michigan sued by 16 former hockey players alleging sexual abuse
news.summary_en: The players say their coach and other staff were aware of sexual hazing that included the forced shaving of their genitals and other abuses by teammates decades ago.
news.author: Ed White AP

news.title: Michigan colleges spend big on dorms as enrollments sag. Big draw or big waste?
news.summary_en: Ferris State’s new dorm offers views of its football stadium. Western’s new hall is made of timber and has massage chairs. But big investments in dorms haven’t always worked in other states.
news.author: Kim Kozlowski
